vibe: Premium, stylish, minimal, inspired by Zara/H&M, editorial, crisp, architectural.

typography.instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all primary headings, particularly in italicized accents to create an editorial feel. Use Manrope for all UI, pricing, and functional elements.

layouts.hero: h-screen w-full flex flex-col justify-end pb-12 relative overflow-hidden
layouts.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-4 gap-y-12 md:gap-x-8 md:gap-y-16
layouts.pdp_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 md:gap-16 min-h-screen

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5, strict rectangular geometry (rounded-none for all UI elements).
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on borders and high contrast for separation. Minimal drop shadow only on the cart drawer or sticky header.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Images scale up slightly (1.05) inside an overflow-hidden container. Buttons invert colors (black to white, white to black).

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic text reveal: words translated up from behind an overflow-hidden mask with staggered delays.
motion.scroll_animations: Fade in and slight upward translation (y: 20 -> 0) on scroll using Framer Motion whileInView.
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle background image parallax in hero and large editorial banners.
motion.smooth_scroll: Implement standard Lenis smooth scrolling wrapper at the root.

components.Button: Sharp corners (rounded-none), border border-black, px-8 py-3. Default: bg-black text-white. Outline: bg-transparent text-black.
components.ProductCard: Aspect ratio 3:4 or 4:5 image. Minimal text below: Title left, Price right, in Manrope. Hidden 'Quick Add' button reveals on image hover.
components.Header: Sticky, fixed top, bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md, border-b border-gray-200. Clear typography, simple flex layout.
components.Marquee: Editorial ribbon using react-fast-marquee. Massive text or elegant small serif ribbon. Example: 'NEW ARRIVALS — THE SPRING EDIT — FREE SHIPPING'.

hero_women.description: Full body editorial pose, female model in Berlin studio, perfect for the main landing page hero.

hero_men.description: Stylish male model posing in beige coat, perfect for the Men's category highlight.

editorial_accent.description: Woman in black blazer, great for secondary banner or manifesto section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images has a slight gradient overlay or text-shadow if necessary. Maintain 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) must have data-testid attributes.

tech_stack.state: Zustand or React Context + localStorage for Cart and Wishlist
tech_stack.components: shadcn/ui (heavily customized for 'rounded-none' and pure black/white)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Configure Tailwind to include Cormorant Garamond and Manrope.
Remove all 'rounded' classes from shadcn components. The brand is strictly sharp corners.
Build the Kinetic Hero: Use Framer Motion to mask and slide up massive typography on load.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling in a global wrapper.
Create a responsive Navbar with a search overlay, cart drawer, and login modal.
Build product listing pages with filtering/sorting UI.
Build the product detail page with sticky images on the left and scrolling details on the right.
Ensure all state (cart, wishlist) persists in localStorage using a custom hook or context.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and major sections.

universal_guidelines.avoid_slop: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth with stark contrast and typography.
universal_guidelines.no_emoji: Never use AI emojis as icons.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use p-8, p-12, p-24 aggressively to create editorial whitespace.
universal_guidelines.animations: Every hover should have a purpose (e.g., image scale, button color invert). Entrance animations are mandatory for product grids.
